titulo.alumno:
«Правило учреждения и исключение»
Reading official rules and instructions

intro: A rule usually states scope, effective date, obligation, exception and procedure; locate who must act and within what deadline.

piezas.titulo: A rule usually states scope, effective date, obligation, exception and procedure; locate who must act and within what deadline.
texto: A rule usually states scope, effective date, obligation, exception and procedure; locate who must act and within what deadline.
Conforme a, excepto, при условии and в случае если can change the scope of a clause.

frases.estudio: Согласно новым правилам заявление рассматривается в течение десяти рабочих дней.
frases.alumno: Under the new rules, the application is examined within ten working days.

frases.estudio: Исключение действует только для документов, поданных до 1 июня.
frases.alumno: The exception applies only to documents submitted before 1 June.

opciones.explicacion: The second sentence expressly limits the exception by date.
